field_checks.summary: Reviewed all 130 activity records and 126 toxicity records against the XML methods and the staged XLSX workbook. Source-cell values and units are mostly source-faithful, including Supplementary Data 4 p17/p20 P. aeruginosa paired ug/mL and uM values, but the current activity final still carries source_review_status=needs_targeted_rework, publication_grade_claim=false, and an unresolved blocker for the same p17/p20 issue, so the current strict acceptance artifact is not reconciled.

Reviewed all 4 database audit objects. Fallback DBAASP machine rows remain unresolved and not promoted, which preserves the release boundary, but the database final still uses non-packet-indexed XML article-id locator strings for citation traceability and claims publication_grade=true while zero authoritative linked rows are present. That is not publication-grade locator provenance for layer 1.

Paper-final and packet-final common JSON files are byte-identical; packet-final mechanism_evidence.json is an identical alias of mechanism_ontology_record.json. Record counts are 130 activity, 126 toxicity, 4 database audits, and 4 mechanism claims. Terminal consistency still fails because live packet state reports analysis_needs_analysis_rework and 11 open rework tickets, while review_report has one rework target and publication_grade=false.

Reviewed all 4 mechanism claims against XML, PDF, and Supplementary Data 9. Evidence classes are separated: PI fluorescence/permeability is direct_mechanism; AlphaFold is computational_only; charge/design rationale is inferred_mechanism; MIC phenotype remains phenotype_supported. No worker artifact is used as a mechanism source_locator.

Paper DOI, PMID, PMCID, title, and candidate entities were source-reviewed. p15, p17, and p20 source sequences in Supplementary Data 3 count exactly to 26, 29, and 32 residues; Supplementary Data 8 AMP15/AMP17/AMP20 benchmark rows are excluded as non-identical comparator surfaces. Caution remains because authoritative linked database rows are absent locally.

Workbook-backed activity/toxicity locators and values resolve, and residue length checks passed for all plain one-letter sequence objects with sequence_length. The failure is layer-1 locator integrity: database citation source_locator_paths use xml:article-id:* strings that are absent from locator_index.json, so those final database citation locators are not packet-resolvable.

No recursive worker artifact remains in source_locator or supporting_source_locators for activity or mechanism claims. DBAASP fallback machine rows are kept as unresolved candidate evidence and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false, so fallback rows remain excluded from RC2, portal, and authoritative ingest.

The real source conflict is p17/p20 P. aeruginosa: XML prose says AMP-17 and AMP-20 are above 25 uM, while the workbook gives exact paired values below that threshold. The activity rows now preserve this conflict, but review_report and activity unresolved_blockers still report the hard finding as open, so the current acceptance artifact is unreconciled.

All staged supplements were readable and inspected: three PDFs have extracted/OCR text and the XLSX has 12 sheets, 1042 nonempty rows, and 15396 nonempty cells indexed. Source exhaustion itself is adequate, but live rework_requests.jsonl and analysis_status.json still list the old worker-3 workbook ticket as open, so terminal ticket state is stale.

Reviewed toxicity/selectivity surfaces. Final toxicity coverage preserves 9 CC50, 9 HC50, 54 hemolysis dose rows, and 54 cell-viability dose rows. The source supports selectivity qualitatively through CC50/HC50 versus MIC comparison, but no separate source SI table was found, so absence of computed selectivity records is acceptable.
